terms.latin: sella lūsōria quae hūc illūc movētur
terms.comment: Our broad description of a moving play seat; it does not name the spring. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a spring rider; Traupman’s nearest is a rocking chair (p. 372).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 372.
